legend.automated: Running behavior checks in CI for automatable acceptance part; never implies editorial or physical-device approval
legend.partial: There is test evidence but at least one substantive rule or verification gate remains
legend.manual: Requires human/real-world investigation; must not be faked by a code test
legend.deferred: Explicitly outside current scope pending a new decision
legend.superseded: Later approved decision replaces the earlier contract
